case_title: SMITH WILLIE VS BAKER GENERAL INSURANCE

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $600.00 FILED BY SMITH WILLIE AS TO DEFENDANT BAKER GENERAL INSURANCE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUN-23-1992 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 03
